summary: Anticipatory bail appeal; caste slur allegation insufficient without public view element; abduction and intimidation allegations inferential; temple trust dispute context; bail granted per Prathvi Raj Chauhan and Shajan Skaria principles; no merit opinion expressed.
legal_provisions_cited: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 s.3(1)(r), s.3(1)(s), s.3(2)(va)
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; anticipatory bail granted subject to trial court conditions; High Court order set aside.
